headline: Department staffing changes for Human Resources, Police, Water Works, Fleet, and Information Systems, plus Youth Services reorganization.
summary: The committee will review requests to add, eliminate, or modify positions in several city departments, including Human Resources, Central Fleet Management, Water Works, Police, and Information Systems. It will also consider a reorganization of the Office of Youth Services, including a Memorandum of Understanding with the Manchester School District.
items: Human Resources Director requests modifying one full-time HR Generalist position, grade 107, to 32 hours per week part-time, grade 112, and eliminating one vacant Administrative Assistant II position, grade 105
Central Fleet Management Director requests adding one full-time Accountant I position, grade 108, and eliminating one full-time Inventory Specialist I position, grade 108

Water Works Director requests eliminating three Accounting Technician II positions, grade 107, adding one Accountant I position, grade 108, and adding two Customer Service Representative III positions, grade 108

Chief of Police requests creating one full-time Administrative Compliance Coordinator position, grade 124, and leaving the Grants Coordinator position, grade 117, and Accreditation Coordinator position, grade 116, vacant

Information Systems Director and Assistant Chief of Police request removing two Computer Systems Specialist II positions, grade 114, from the Police Department and adding two Computer Systems Specialist II positions, grade 114, to the Information Systems Department
Assistant Chief of Police requests adding one full-time Police Financial Administrator position, grade 121, and eliminating one full-time Business Services Manager position, grade 120
Assistant Chief of Police requests adding one full-time Police Lieutenant position, grade 126, to oversee the Parking Unit
Information Systems Director requests adding one full-time Business Services Manager position, grade 120, and eliminating one full-time Office Administrator I position, grade 111
Mayor Ruais requests approval of a reorganization of the Office of Youth Services, including a Memorandum of Understanding with the Manchester School District
plain_text:
COMMITTEE ON HUMAN RESOURCES/INSURANCE 
October 6, 2026 Immediately Following Bills on Second Reading 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Aldermen Goonan, Sapienza, O'Neil, Burkush, Vincent 
 
AGENDA 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Communication from Jaime Corwin, Human Resources Director, requesting the 
following changes to the department's complement: 
• Modification of one (1) full-time HR Generalist position, grade 107, to 32 
hours per week part-time, grade 112; 
• Eliminate one (1) vacant Administrative Assistant II position, grade 105 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
2. Communication from Chris Goodnow, Central Fleet Management Director, 
requesting the following changes to the department's complement: 
• Add one (1) full-time Accountant I position, grade 108 
• Eliminate one (1) full-time Inventory Specialist I position, grade 108 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
3. Communication from Phil Croasdale, Water Works Director, requesting the 
following changes to the department's complement: 
• Eliminate three (3) Accounting Technician II positions, grade 107; 
• Add one (1) Accountant I position, grade 108; 
• Add two (2) Customer Service Representative III positions, grade 108 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure?
October 6, 2026 COMMITTEE ON HUMAN RESOURCES/INSURANCE 
Page 2 of 2 
 
4. Communication from Peter Marr, Chief of Police, requesting the following 
changes to the department's complement: 
• Creation and addition of one (1) full-time Administrative Compliance 
Coordinator, grade 124; 
• Leave the Grants Coordinator position, grade 117, and Accreditation 
Coordinator position, grade 116, vacant 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
5. Communication from Richard Martinez, Information Systems Director, and Ken 
Loui, Assistant Chief of Police, requesting the following changes to their 
departments' complements: 
• Remove two (2) Computer Systems Specialist II positions, grade 114, 
from the Police Department; 
• Add two (2) Computer Systems Specialist II positions, grade 114, to the 
Information Systems Department 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
6. Communication from the Assistant Chief of Police requesting the following 
changes to the department's complement: 
• Add one (1) full-time Police Financial Administrator position, grade 121 
• Eliminate one (1) full-time Business Services Manager, grade 120 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
7. Communication from the Assistant Chief of Police requesting the addition of 
one (1) full-time Police Lieutenant position, grade 126, to the department's 
complement to oversee the Parking Unit. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
8. Communication from the Information Systems Director requesting the following 
changes to the department's complement: 
• Add one (1) full-time Business Services Manager position, grade 120 
• Eliminate one (1) full-time Office Administrator I position, grade 111 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
9. Communication from Mayor Ruais requesting approval of a reorganization of 
the Office of Youth Services, including entering into a Memorandum of 
Understanding with the Manchester School District. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
